tools.name: list_rules
tools.description: List the full pattern corpus (categories + every rule with id, severity, kind, match, fix). Use this to know what the scanner flags.

tools.name: scan_text
tools.description: Scan plain text for AI-slop writing tells. Returns score (0-100), verdict, per-category breakdown, and every match with a fix suggestion.

tools.name: scan_html
tools.description: Scan HTML markup for AI-slop writing AND visual design tells (gradients, kickers, glassmorphism, stat rows, ...).

tools.name: scan_project
tools.description: Scan a local directory tree (prose/markup/styles/code lenses) and return a pooled report: score, top offending files, category breakdown. Local filesystem access only.

tools.name: scan_render
tools.description: Run the rendered-tier design checks (r-*): kicker size, gradient text, tracked caps, glued arrows, marquee, hidden reveal, fold budget, screen word budget, section rhythm, fake progress, and WCAG contrast — all pure functions over a computed snapshot ({elements:[...]}, see src/render-checks.js). Pas

tools.name: rewrite_text
tools.description: Apply conservative safe rewrites (whole-word synonym swaps and phrase deletions only) to a text. Returns the rewritten text plus the change list.

tools.name: judge
tools.description: Run the judgement checklist (--judge) over text, HTML, or a directory: the 5-question review (purpose/audience/decision/variety/defaults) with machine-flagged signals per question, a craft-floor gate (contrast/alignment/text-hierarchy/spacing/no-fake-data/no-decorative-effects) mapped from scanner e
